title: Within the window, a delegate_workers call asked for by another person than the room's last one is not served that answer: the team runs again, its review headed by who asked this time
notes: Python: tests/test_supervisor.py::TestStrategyToolHandler::test_strategy_tool_dedup_serves_only_the_same_asker; orchestration/strategies/supervisor/_inject_strategy.py _StrategyToolServer.serve (the dedup cache keeps who asked, current_tool_requester). The same asker's repeat reads the last answer (a-repeated-team-call-reads-the-room-s-last-answer). The window is wall-clock: the scenario runs well within it.
